versions.content: Required DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFI- CATION for events If an DemEvent refers an DemDTC that itself requires snap- shot record or extended data records that contain a DemInternalDataElement = DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFICATION , the DemEventAssociatedIden- tification shall be configured for that event.
